body.statement: At the prespecified sharp-zero null \(h=0\), for every realized label \(C=C_n(\rho)\) with \(p_{\mathrm{ref}}(n,C,\mathcal D_n^{0,\rho},\rho)>0\) and every active \(j=(C,s)\in J\), the upper-rank selective randomization \(p\)-value from \(\mathrm{def{:}selective\mbox{-}test}\) is superuniform conditional on \(E_{n,C}(\rho)\) under \(\mathsf P_n^{0,\rho}\). Because \(Y^{(0)}(1)=Y^{(0)}(0)=B\), the conditional true chronological assignment law has exactly the support \(\Omega_{n,C}(\mathcal D_n^{0,\rho},\rho)\) and equals \(\mathsf R_{n,\mathcal D(\rho)}^{0,C}\); summing its explicit product masses preserves level \(\alpha\).
body.justification: This establishes finite-sample design-based validity on the same complete signed conditioning event used by every power theorem.
body.gap: It specializes the exact conditioning argument of Freidling, Zhao, and Gao to the proposed threshold-and-holdout design; no novelty is claimed for validity alone.
body.consumer: A trial team can deploy the optimized design without replacing exact sharp-null randomization inference by an asymptotic test.
